translations.literal: At the time Hanlin Academician Zhu Zhen said: "When Tang Dezong in the Jianzhong era conferred an honorific title on Empress Dowager Shen, Empress Dowager Shen's whereabouts were unknown; yet they still set out Hanyuan Hall, prepared the ceremonial robe and cap, came out from the left sequence, stood facing east, and bowed twice in presenting the patent.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Hanlin Academician Zhu Zhen said: "When Tang Dezong in the Jianzhong era conferred an honorific title on Empress Dowager Shen, her whereabouts were unknown. Yet the court still prepared Hanyuan Hall, laid out the ceremonial robe and cap, came out from the left sequence, stood facing east, and bowed twice in presenting the patent.

sentences.zh: 今太后聖體無恙，信使相望，豈可不舉揚前憲？

translations.literal: Now the empress dowager's sacred person is unharmed; messengers come and go in sight of one another; how can we not uphold and display the former statute?
translations.idiomatic: Now the empress dowager is in good health and messengers pass continually between us. How can we fail to uphold the former precedent?

sentences.zh: 臣又聞，三年之製，惟天地、社稷越紼行事。

translations.literal: Your subject has also heard that in the three-year regulation, only toward Heaven and Earth and the altars of soil and grain does one pass the mourning sash to perform affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject has also heard that under the three-year mourning regulation, only rites to Heaven and Earth and the altars of soil and grain may be performed by passing the mourning sash aside.

sentences.zh: 德宗以大曆十四年即位，明年改元建中，時行易月之 製，故以冕服行事。

translations.literal: Dezong ascended the throne in the fourteenth year of Dali; the next year he changed the era name to Jianzhong; at the time the shortened-month regulation was in force; therefore he performed the affair in cap and robe.
translations.idiomatic: Dezong ascended the throne in Dali 14 and changed the era name to Jianzhong the following year. At that time the shortened-month mourning regulation was in force, so he performed the ceremony in cap and robe.

sentences.zh: 今陛下退朝之服，盡如禮製，謂當供張別殿，遣三公奉冊，冊藏於有司，恭俟來歸。

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty's dress after retiring from court fully follows ritual regulation; I say that a separate hall should be set out, the Three Ducal Ministers dispatched to present the patent, the patent stored with the relevant offices, and respectfully awaited until her return.
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty's dress after retiring from court fully follows ritual regulation. I propose that a separate hall be prepared, the Three Ducal Ministers be dispatched to present the patent, the patent be stored with the relevant offices, and the ceremony await her return with all due respect.

sentences.zh: 願下禮官講明。”

translations.literal: I wish that ritual officers below be ordered to clarify this."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the ritual officers be ordered to clarify this matter."

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict followed this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 禮部、太常言：“寶文欲乞以‘ 皇太后寶’四字為文，合差撰冊文官一員，書冊文官一員，書篆寶文官一員，並差執政。”

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites and the Temple of Rites said: "For the seal inscription we wish to request using the four characters 'Empress Dowager's Seal' as the text; in all one official should be assigned to draft the patent text, one to inscribe the patent text, and one to inscribe the seal text in seal script; all should be drawn from the chief ministers."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites and the Temple of Rites reported: "For the seal inscription we request the four characters 'Empress Dowager's Seal.' One official should be assigned to draft the patent text, one to inscribe it, and one to inscribe the seal text in seal script; all should be drawn from the chief ministers."

sentences.zh: 十年，營建皇太后宮，以慈寧為名。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, the empress dowager's palace was constructed, taking Cining as its name.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, the empress dowager's palace was built and named Cining.

sentences.zh: 十二月，帝自常禦殿詣慈寧殿遙賀皇 太后，奉上冊寶。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the emperor, from Changyu Hall, proceeded to Cining Hall to offer congratulations from afar to the empress dowager and present the patent and seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the emperor proceeded from Changyu Hall to Cining Hall to offer congratulations from afar to the empress dowager and present the patent and seal.

sentences.zh: 十二年八月，皇太后還慈寧宮，十月十八日，奉進冊寶。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twelfth year, the empress dowager returned to Cining Palace; on the eighteenth day of the tenth month, the patent and seal were presented.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twelfth year the empress dowager returned to Cining Palace. On the eighteenth day of the tenth month the patent and seal were formally presented.

sentences.zh: 其日張設慈寧殿，設坐殿中，皇太后服禕衣即御坐，本殿官設冊寶於殿下， 慈寧宮事務官並本殿官並朝服詣殿下，再拜，搢笏，舉冊寶奉進；

translations.literal: On that day Cining Hall was set out; a seat was placed in the hall; the empress dowager, wearing the yi robe, immediately took the imperial seat; officials of the hall set the patent and seal below the hall; officials in charge of Cining Palace affairs and officials of the hall alike, in court dress, proceeded below the hall, bowed twice, inserted their tablets, raised the patent and seal and presented them;
translations.idiomatic: On that day Cining Hall was prepared and a seat placed in the hall. The empress dowager, wearing the yi robe, took the imperial seat. Officials of the hall set the patent and seal below the hall. Officials in charge of Cining Palace affairs and hall officials alike, in court dress, proceeded below the hall, bowed twice, inserted their tablets, and raised the patent and seal to present them;

sentences.zh: 先進冊，次進寶，進畢，降坐，易禕衣，服常服。

translations.literal: first the patent was presented, next the seal; when presentation was complete, she descended from the seat, changed out of the yi robe, and wore ordinary dress.
translations.idiomatic: the patent was presented first and then the seal. When the presentation was complete, she left the seat, changed out of the yi robe, and put on ordinary dress.

sentences.zh: 皇帝詣慈寧殿賀，如宮中儀，次宰臣率百僚拜表 稱賀。

translations.literal: The emperor proceeded to Cining Hall to offer congratulations, as in inner-palace ceremony; next chief ministers led the hundred officials in bowing and presenting memorials of congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor proceeded to Cining Hall to offer congratulations according to inner-palace ceremony. Chief ministers then led all officials in bowing and submitting congratulatory memorials.

sentences.zh: 三十二年六月，詔上太上皇帝、太上皇后尊號，集議以聞。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the thirty-second year, an edict ordered that honorific titles be conferred on the Supreme Emperor and Supreme Empress; deliberations were assembled and reported.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the thirty-second year, an edict ordered honorific titles for the Supreme Emperor and Supreme Empress, and deliberations were assembled and reported.

sentences.zh: 左仆射陳康伯等言：“五帝之壽，惟堯最高，百王之聖，惟堯獨冠。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director Chen Kangbo and others said: "Among the Five Emperors in longevity, only Yao was highest; among the hundred kings in sageliness, only Yao stood alone at the crown.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director Chen Kangbo and others said: "Among the Five Emperors, only Yao lived longest; among the hundred kings, only Yao stood supreme in sagely virtue.

sentences.zh: 今茲高世之舉， 視堯有光，恭請上太上皇帝尊號曰光堯壽聖太上皇帝，太上皇后尊號曰壽聖太上皇后。”

translations.literal: Now this exalted act surpassing the age sheds light when compared with Yao; we respectfully request conferring on the Supreme Emperor the honorific title Guangyao Shousheng Supreme Emperor, and on the Supreme Empress the honorific title Shousheng Supreme Empress."
translations.idiomatic: Now this exalted act surpassing the age shines when compared with Yao. We respectfully request conferring on the Supreme Emperor the honorific title Guangyao Shousheng Supreme Emperor and on the Supreme Empress the honorific title Shousheng Supreme Empress."

sentences.zh: 詔恭依，仍令禮部、太常討論禮儀以聞。

translations.literal: An edict respectfully followed this, and still ordered the Ministry of Rites and the Temple of Rites to discuss ceremonial propriety and report.
translations.idiomatic: An edict respectfully approved the proposal and ordered the Ministry of Rites and the Temple of Rites to discuss the ceremonial regulations and report.

sentences.zh: 左仆射陳康伯撰太上皇帝冊文，兼 禮儀使、參政汪澈書冊文並篆寶，知樞密院葉義問撰太上皇后冊文，同知樞密院事黃祖舜書冊文。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director Chen Kangbo drafted the Supreme Emperor's patent text; Concurrent Commissioner of Ceremonial Propriety and Vice Grand Councilor Wang Che inscribed the patent text and carved the seal in seal script; Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Ye Yiwen drafted the Supreme Empress's patent text; Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Huang Zushun inscribed the patent text.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director Chen Kangbo drafted the Supreme Emperor's patent text. Concurrent Commissioner of Ceremonial Propriety and Vice Grand Councilor Wang Che inscribed the patent text and carved the seal in seal script. Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Ye Yiwen drafted the Supreme Empress's patent text, and Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Huang Zushun inscribed it.

sentences.zh: 八月十四日，奉上冊寶。

translations.literal: On the fourteenth day of the eighth month, the patent and seal were presented.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourteenth day of the eighth month the patent and seal were presented.

sentences.zh: 是日，陪位文武百僚、太傅以下行事官，並朝服入詣大慶殿下立班。

translations.literal: On that day, civil and military officials of the hundred ranks attending in place, and acting officials from the Grand Preceptor downward, all in court dress entered, proceeded below Daqing Hall, and stood in ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On that day civil and military officials attending in place and acting officials from the Grand Preceptor downward, all in court dress, entered and took their ranks below Daqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 皇帝自內服履袍入禦幄，服通天冠、絳紗袍出至大慶殿，詣冊寶褥位前再拜，在位官皆再拜訖，皇帝行發冊寶授太傅之禮如儀。

translations.literal: The emperor, from within wearing court robes, entered the imperial curtain; wearing the Tongtian cap and crimson gauze robe he came forth to Daqing Hall, proceeded before the patent and seal cushion and bowed twice; when all officials in attendance had bowed twice, the emperor performed the rite of issuing the patent and seal and presenting them to the Grand Preceptor according to ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, wearing court robes within, entered the imperial curtain. Wearing the Tongtian cap and crimson gauze robe he came forth to Daqing Hall, proceeded to the patent and seal cushion, and bowed twice. After all officials in attendance had bowed twice, the emperor performed the rite of issuing the patent and seal and presenting them to the Grand Preceptor according to ceremony.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，皇帝還幄，服履袍還內，文武百僚退。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete, the emperor returned to the curtain, changed into court robes, and returned within; civil and military officials of the hundred ranks withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were complete, the emperor returned to the curtain, changed into court robes, and returned to the inner palace. Civil and military officials withdrew.

sentences.zh: 儀仗鼓吹，

translations.literal: Guard of honor and ceremonial music,
translations.idiomatic: Guard of honor and ceremonial music,

sentences.zh: 〈（備而不作。）〉

translations.literal: (Prepared but not performed.)
translations.idiomatic: (Prepared but not performed.)

sentences.zh: 護衛冊寶，太傅以下行事官導從冊寶至德壽宮。

translations.literal: escorting the patent and seal, acting officials from the Grand Preceptor downward guided and followed the patent and seal to Deshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: escorted the patent and seal as acting officials from the Grand Preceptor downward guided them to Deshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 皇帝自祥曦殿服履袍乘輦，至德壽宮大次降輦，陪位文武官入殿庭立班定，太傅以下行 事官從冊寶入殿，皇帝服通天冠、絳紗袍升殿，詣西向褥位立，太上皇帝自宮服履袍即坐，皇帝北向四拜起居訖，次太傅以下皆四拜起居。

translations.literal: The emperor, from Xiangxi Hall wearing court robes, rode the imperial carriage; arriving at the great side hall of Deshou Palace he descended from the carriage; civil and military officials attending in place entered the hall court and stood in fixed ranks; acting officials from the Grand Preceptor downward followed the patent and seal into the hall; the emperor, wearing the Tongtian cap and crimson gauze robe, ascended the hall, proceeded to the western-facing cushion and stood; the Supreme Emperor, from within the palace wearing court robes, immediately took his seat; the emperor, facing north, four times bowed in reporting on health; next the Grand Preceptor and below all four times bowed in reporting on health.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, wearing court robes, rode the imperial carriage from Xiangxi Hall. At the great side hall of Deshou Palace he dismounted. Civil and military officials attending in place entered the hall court and took their fixed ranks. Acting officials from the Grand Preceptor downward followed the patent and seal into the hall. The emperor, wearing the Tongtian cap and crimson gauze robe, ascended the hall and stood at the western-facing cushion. The Supreme Emperor, wearing court robes within the palace, took his seat. The emperor, facing north, bowed four times in reporting on his health. The Grand Preceptor and those below then all bowed four times in reporting on health.

sentences.zh: 次行奉冊之 禮，中書令、參知政事史浩讀冊，攝侍中葉義問讀寶，讀訖，退復位。

translations.literal: Next the rite of presenting the patent was performed; Director of the Secretariat and Vice Grand Councilor Shi Hao read the patent; Acting Palace Attendant Ye Yiwen read the seal; when reading was finished, they withdrew and returned to their places.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the rite of presenting the patent. Director of the Secretariat and Vice Grand Councilor Shi Hao read the patent, and Acting Palace Attendant Ye Yiwen read the seal. When the reading was finished, they withdrew and returned to their places.

sentences.zh: 皇帝再拜稱賀曰：“皇帝臣某稽首言：伏惟光堯壽聖太上皇帝陛下冊寶告成，鴻名肇正，與天 同壽，率土均歡。”

translations.literal: The emperor bowed twice and offered congratulations, saying: "The emperor, your subject So-and-so, kowtows and says: Humbly considering that Your Majesty the Guangyao Shousheng Supreme Emperor's patent and seal are announced complete, the great name is newly established, sharing Heaven's longevity; throughout the land all equally rejoice."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor bowed twice and offered congratulations, saying: "The emperor, your subject, kowtows and reports: Humbly considering that Your Majesty the Guangyao Shousheng Supreme Emperor's patent and seal are now complete and the great name newly established, may you share Heaven's longevity; throughout the land all rejoice equally."

sentences.zh: 皇帝再拜，次侍中承旨宣答曰：“皇帝孝通天地，禮備古今，勉受鴻名，良深感慰。”

translations.literal: The emperor bowed twice; next the Palace Attendant received instructions and proclaimed the reply: "The emperor's filial piety penetrates Heaven and Earth; rites are complete through past and present; I reluctantly accept the great name, and my feeling of deep consolation is truly great."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor bowed twice. The Palace Attendant then received instructions and proclaimed the reply: "The emperor's filial piety reaches through Heaven and Earth and his rites are complete through past and present. I reluctantly accept this great name, and my gratitude and consolation are profound."

sentences.zh: 皇帝再拜訖，西向立，次太傅以下再拜稱賀致詞曰：“攝 太傅、尚書左仆射臣康伯等稽首言：伏惟光堯壽聖太上皇帝陛下肅臨寶位，誕受丕稱，獨推天父之尊，普慰帝臣之願。”

translations.literal: When the emperor had finished bowing twice, he stood facing west; next the Grand Preceptor and below bowed twice and offered congratulations with a formal address, saying: "Acting Grand Preceptor, Director of the Left Secretariat, your subject Kangbo and others kowtow and say: Humbly considering that Your Majesty the Guangyao Shousheng Supreme Emperor solemnly presides over the precious throne, newly receives the great title, uniquely extending the honor of Heaven's father, universally comforting the wishes of the emperor's ministers."
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor had finished bowing twice, he stood facing west. The Grand Preceptor and those below then bowed twice and offered congratulations with a formal address: "Acting Grand Preceptor and Director of the Left Secretariat, your subject Kangbo and others kowtow and report: Humbly considering that Your Majesty the Guangyao Shousheng Supreme Emperor solemnly presides over the throne and has newly received this great title, uniquely extending the honor due Heaven's father and universally fulfilling the wishes of the emperor's ministers."

sentences.zh: 奏訖，再拜舞蹈。

translations.literal: When the memorial was finished, they bowed twice and performed the dance.
translations.idiomatic: When the address was finished, they bowed twice and performed the dance.

sentences.zh: 次侍中承旨宣答曰：“光 堯壽聖太上皇帝聖旨：倦勤滋久，佚老是圖，勉受嘉名，但增感慰。”

translations.literal: Next the Palace Attendant received instructions and proclaimed the reply: "The Guangyao Shousheng Supreme Emperor's holy edict: Weariness in diligence has long increased; retirement and old age are my aim; I reluctantly accept the fine name, but my feeling of gratitude and consolation only increases."
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant then received instructions and proclaimed the reply: "The Guangyao Shousheng Supreme Emperor's edict: Weariness in diligence has long grown; retirement and old age are my aim. I reluctantly accept this fine name, but my gratitude and consolation only increase."

sentences.zh: 又再拜舞蹈。

translations.literal: Again they bowed twice and performed the dance.
translations.idiomatic: Again they bowed twice and performed the dance.

sentences.zh: 次太上皇帝降坐入宮，皇帝後從壽聖太上皇后冊寶入宮。

translations.literal: Next the Supreme Emperor descended from the seat and entered the palace; the emperor followed afterward with the Shousheng Supreme Empress's patent and seal into the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Supreme Emperor left his seat and entered the palace. The emperor followed with the Shousheng Supreme Empress's patent and seal into the palace.

sentences.zh: 皇帝詣太 上皇后坐前北向立，太上皇后升坐，皇帝四拜起居，行奉上冊寶之禮，讀冊官陳子常讀冊，讀寶官梁康民讀寶，讀訖復位，皇帝再拜稱賀致詞曰：“皇帝臣某稽首 言：伏惟壽聖太上皇后殿下德茂坤元，禮崇大號，寶書翕受，歡抃無疆。”

translations.literal: The emperor proceeded before the Supreme Empress's seat and stood facing north; the Supreme Empress ascended and took her seat; the emperor four times bowed in reporting on health; the rite of presenting the patent and seal was performed; Patent Reader Chen Zichang read the patent; Seal Reader Liang Kangmin read the seal; when reading was finished they returned to their places; the emperor bowed twice and offered congratulations with a formal address, saying: "The emperor, your subject So-and-so, kowtows and says: Humbly considering that Your Highness the Shousheng Supreme Empress's virtue flourishes in the earth's origin, rites honor the great title, the precious document is harmoniously received; joyful exultation is without bound."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor proceeded before the Supreme Empress's seat and stood facing north. The Supreme Empress ascended and took her seat. The emperor bowed four times in reporting on her health and performed the rite of presenting the patent and seal. Patent Reader Chen Zichang read the patent and Seal Reader Liang Kangmin read the seal; when the reading was finished they returned to their places. The emperor bowed twice and offered congratulations with a formal address: "The emperor, your subject, kowtows and reports: Humbly considering that Your Highness the Shousheng Supreme Empress's virtue flourishes in the earth's origin and rites honor this great title, the precious document is graciously received and our joy knows no bounds."

sentences.zh: 皇帝再拜，次宣答官承旨宣答曰：“壽聖太上皇后教旨：皇帝祲容載蕆，顯號來膺，誠孝 通天，但深感惕。”

translations.literal: The emperor bowed twice; next the reply-proclaiming official received instructions and proclaimed the reply: "The Shousheng Supreme Empress's instruction: The emperor's reverent bearing carries deep sincerity; the illustrious title comes to be received; sincere filial piety penetrates Heaven; but my feeling of deep reverence and caution is great."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor bowed twice. The reply-proclaiming official then received instructions and proclaimed the reply: "The Shousheng Supreme Empress's instruction: The emperor's reverent bearing carries deep sincerity; the illustrious title comes to be received; his sincere filial piety reaches through Heaven—but my feeling of deep reverence and caution is profound."

sentences.zh: 皇帝再拜訖，太上皇后降坐入宮。

translations.literal: When the emperor had finished bowing twice, the Supreme Empress descended from the seat and entered the palace.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor had finished bowing twice, the Supreme Empress left her seat and entered the palace.

sentences.zh: 次太傅以下文武百僚就德壽殿下拜箋稱賀以俟，皇帝服履袍乘輦還內。

translations.literal: Next civil and military officials of the hundred ranks from the Grand Preceptor downward, below Deshou Hall, bowed and submitted letters of congratulation to wait; the emperor, wearing court robes, rode the imperial carriage and returned within.
translations.idiomatic: Next civil and military officials from the Grand Preceptor downward, below Deshou Hall, bowed and submitted letters of congratulation to wait. The emperor, wearing court robes, rode the imperial carriage and returned to the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 十六日，宰臣率文武百僚詣文德殿拜表 稱賀。

translations.literal: On the sixteenth day, chief ministers led civil and military officials of the hundred ranks to proceed to Wende Hall, bow, and present memorials of congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixteenth day chief ministers led all civil and military officials to Wende Hall to bow and submit congratulatory memorials.
